Six things the desk does before a name reaches you.
One company, and nothing to average it against. The desk puts the evidence on the record before the letter is priced.
The sector
Mapped before you commit
The companies in it, the buyers active in it, and where its deals break, so one transaction is chosen from the whole sector rather than from what arrived.
The evidence
Before the letter is priced
One company, and nothing to average it against. Revenue reconciled to bank deposits and every adjustment marked, before exclusivity, not during it.
The owners
Known ahead of a process
Relationships built before a banker is hired, so a sponsor with a specific thesis is already known when the owner decides.
The equity story

The evidence a sponsor raises equity on, assembled before the raise, so the capital arrives with the letter rather than after it.

Read from the record
Independent sponsors held broken letters 129 days on average in the published study, longer than private equity buyers. The desk shortens the part of that time spent finding out.

Scored against your criteria
Each business scored and ranked against criteria and weights you approved. You decide which to pursue.

sections.name: Plain answers, then a conversation if you want one.

items.text: Independent sponsors · Questions
Plain answers, then a conversation if you want one.
Why does one transaction change the evidence standard?

A fund averages its mistakes across a portfolio. A sponsor has one company. The findings that a fund absorbs are the findings that end a sponsor’s deal, so they have to be on the record before the letter is priced.
What does criteria on file ask of me?
Your criteria, confirmed with you each quarter. A dedicated search in one sector is by exception, with scope agreed in writing.
Can the desk help with the financing?

Capital Connections introduces financing needs it has already read to financing providers. The provider handles its application, underwriting and credit decision. The SBA acquisition loan rules are on the Insights page.
Do you represent the seller as well?
Never on the same transaction. Capital Row acts for one side, under a scope agreed in writing.
What is the first conversation?
What you are looking at, and where you are in the process. One business day, read by a person.
